title: Web platform for prospective student enrollment
description: Graduation project consisting of a complete web platform to manage the enrollment process for new students, facilitating registration, document validation, and tracking of the admission process.

title: Electoral campaign website for city councilor
description: Informational website for city councilor political campaign, including proposals, biography, news, and contact form for voters.

title: Job platform with RESTful API + Android mobile application
description: Complete job board system with REST API backend for managing job offers, resumes, and applications, complemented by native Android mobile application for candidates.

title: CRM system for insurance company
description: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system specialized for the insurance sector, including policy management, customer tracking, renewals, and sales reports.

title: Mobile and desktop application for RETIE inspection
description: Comprehensive solution for conducting technical inspections according to RETIE regulations (Technical Regulation for Electrical Installations), with mobile app for field data capture and desktop software for automatic PDF certificate generation.

title: Functional Nequi clone / digital wallet
description: Complete implementation of a digital wallet inspired by Nequi for educational purposes, including web app, REST API, and mobile application. Features include transfers, payments, recharge, and balance inquiry.

title: Web platform for dynamic forms with user configuration
description: Advanced system that allows users to create and configure dynamic forms visually, with public APIs for data querying. Forms are generated based on customizable configurations without the need for programming.
challenges: Create a flexible form engine that allows completely dynamic configuration without sacrificing performance or security.
solutions: Implementation of a JSON Schema-based engine with validation on both client and server, intelligent caching, and GraphQL API for efficient queries.
results: 80% reduction in development time for new forms, over 500 active configurations.

title: Maintenance and new features in document management platform
description: Evolutionary and corrective maintenance of enterprise document management platform, implementing new features for advanced search, document versioning, and approval workflows.

title: New implementations in project management platform
description: Development of new modules and improvements in enterprise project management platform, including Kanban boards, resource management, and advanced analytical reports.

title: Automated Selenium bot for web application warm-up
description: Automated bot that performs simulated browsing on web applications to keep them active and preloaded, reducing first-load times for actual users. Implemented with Selenium and task scheduling.

title: Improvements and updates in bus management platform
description: Update and improvement of bus fleet management system, including route optimization, real-time GPS tracking, and preventive maintenance management.

title: Complete migration of institutional knowledge database
description: Data migration project from legacy system to new knowledge management platform, including cleaning, transformation, and validation of thousands of documents and historical records.

title: ERP + web POS platform for supply companies
description: Complete enterprise system integrating ERP and web point of sale for local supply companies, with inventory management, billing, customers, suppliers, and accounting reports.

title: Platform for business loan management
description: Business loan administration system with application management, credit analysis, disbursements, amortization, and collection. Includes rate calculation engine and amortization table generation.

title: Consulting for veterinary clinic management platform creation
description: Technical and architectural consulting for the design and implementation of veterinary clinic management system, including medical records, appointment scheduling, medication inventory, and billing.

title: File synchronization system (console + REST microservice + web)
description: Comprehensive automatic file synchronization system between servers, composed of console application for synchronization, REST microservice for management, and web application for visualization and monitoring.

title: Web design migration for online course platform
description: Complete user interface redesign for LMS (Learning Management System) platform, implementing new responsive design, improving accessibility, and updating frontend technology stack.

title: Web application for signing and uploading PDF files
description: Web tool that allows uploading PDF documents, inserting digital signature from predetermined image, and storing signed documents. Useful for automating mass signing processes.

title: Migration of console application for file conversion
description: Modernization of legacy console application that performs file conversion on server, migrating to .NET Core, optimizing performance, and containerizing with Docker for cloud deployment.

title: Desktop application for PDF file signing and conversion
description: Desktop software that allows signing PDF files with custom signature, converting PDF pages to individual images, and generating a new PDF document with the images resulting from the signing and conversion process.

title: Carpooling platform with DDD architecture
description: Carpooling (ride-sharing) platform designed with Domain-Driven Design (DDD), implementing microservices architecture, automated deployment with CI/CD, and high scalability.
challenges: Implement pure DDD architecture with microservices while maintaining data consistency and high availability.
solutions: Event sourcing, CQRS, saga pattern for distributed transactions, API Gateway, and service mesh with Istio.
results: Highly scalable system with automated deployment, architecture prepared for exponential growth.

title: Platform for corrosion calculations in industrial systems
description: Specialized web system for engineers that allows performing complex corrosion calculations in industrial systems, with specialized formulas, technical report generation, and PDF export.

title: Comprehensive platform for supplier evaluation and document management
description: Complete system for supplier evaluation and rating, document management of certifications, performance tracking, audits, and compliance report generation.
challenges: Manage complex multi-level approval workflows and maintain complete traceability of evaluations.
solutions: Implementation of configurable workflow engine, automatic change auditing, and real-time notifications.
results: Evaluation process optimization with 60% reduction in supplier approval time.

title: Enrollment and administrative management platform for higher education
description: Comprehensive academic and administrative management system for higher education institution, including modules for applications, enrollments, academic program management, students, teachers, and institutional report generation.
challenges: Handle massive enrollment periods with thousands of concurrent users and ensure data integrity in critical processes.
solutions: Scalable architecture with distributed cache, query optimization with specialized indexes, asynchronous processing of heavy tasks.
results: Support for 10,000+ students, automation of 85% of administrative processes, 70% reduction in enrollment times.
